purpose: Held-out evaluation set for runbook retrieval. Every prompt is a paraphrase of a case in dataset_ubuntu_easy.json, written in wording a real user would type and deliberately NOT reusing the trigger_signatures.symptoms text of the runbook it should match. Measuring retrieval on the verbatim dataset prompts would grade the matcher on sentences that were copied into the runbooks themselves; this set measures generalisation instead.
